title: 7kVA Inverter — What Can It Run?
author: Syed Solar Energy
excerpt: A practical look at appliances a 7kVA inverter can safely power.
content:
A 7kVA inverter (~5600W–6000W usable) can handle **fans, lights, fridge, LED TV**, and in many cases a **1-ton inverter AC** if surge is managed.

> Always consult our team for wiring and breaker sizing.
